INSTRUCTIONS

You will hear a series of tones.

- When you hear the LOW-pitched tone, press the button as quickly as you can.
- When you hear the HIGH-pitched tone, do not press anything.

Respond only to the low-pitched (Go) tone. You have a short window after each tone to respond.

The task takes about 3 minutes with no breaks. Try to stay focused and still, and keep your eyes on the cross in the middle of the screen.
START: When you are ready, make the response shown below to begin.
FEEDBACK_MISS: Missed: press for the low tone
FEEDBACK_FA: Wrong: do not press for the high tone
